payload.prompt:
*"Design a highly advanced blockchain game smart contract in Solidity (≥0.8.19), combining multiple systems into one extensible architecture. The game should include:
NFT Items (ERC721) with soulbound mechanics, dynamic stats that evolve with usage, rarity levels, and metadata storage.
In-game currency (ERC20-like token) with minting, burning, allowances, and vesting schedules for play-to-earn rewards.
Crafting system with Chainlink VRF randomness for probabilistic item generation, supporting multiple recipes with variable outcomes.
Player reputation system that affects loot drop chances, marketplace discounts, or guild eligibility.
Marketplace (Auctions) supporting both English and Dutch auctions for items, with safe ETH transfers and anti-reentrancy protections.
Guild system with roles (Leader, Officer, Member), guild reputation, and on-chain governance actions.
Land ownership and rentals for passive income mechanics.
PvP tournaments and seasonal events with entry fees, prize pools, time locks, and automated winner distribution.
Cross-chain bridging support for NFTs and tokens, including emitting events for off-chain relayers.
Anti-bot protections with ZK-proof placeholders or signature verification.
Upgradeable design (using UUPS or proxy pattern) so new features can be added later.
Events for all major actions (crafting, battles, auctions, guild joins, rentals, etc.) for analytics dashboards.
Code must:
Be self-contained and compilable without external imports beyond OpenZeppelin.
Follow best practices for security (reentrancy guards, input validation, safe transfers).
Use modular struct/enums for clarity.
Include clear comments explaining the purpose of each subsystem.
